about_the_game:
Caustic Murmurs is a Yuri/GL Visual Novel. Miu, a shy young woman, braces herself for an arranged marriage, expecting to meet a husband she barely knows. But when she discovers her spouse-to-be is the enigmatic and captivating Unizuma Eri, a beautiful young woman, Miu’s world turns upside down.

Planned content:

  • Roughly 5 hours of story

  • 20+ beautifully hand-drawn CGs and sprites

  • Captivating lore and mysteries

  • Fully voiced in Japanese

Characters:

Miu

Miu is a shy girl, often hesitant and overwhelmed by the weight of her family’s expectations. Her journey is one of finding confidence and embracing her true self.

Eri

Eri is mysterious and confident, her striking presence and subtle charm captivating Miu from their first meeting. Her enigmatic past holds secrets that unravel through your decisions, deepening the bond and revealing hidden truths.

Mari

Mari, the head maid, is motherly and nurturing, offering warmth and wisdom amidst uncertainty. Her gentle guidance hides a quiet strength. Her motherly care anchors the household.

Arisa

Arisa is a cheeky brat with a tsundere edge, her sharp wit and playful teasing masking a caring heart. Breaking through her guarded facade reveals a loyal friend who challenges Miu to be bolder.

Runa

Runa is quiet and aloof, keeping her distance at first. But she's a good girl and only wants what's best for everyone.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.0 GHz or equivalent)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
